messages:
alex_csops: Heads-up: we just had a wave of churn-alert emails go to sandbox/test accounts and a couple internal owners. Seeing ~27 sends in the last 20m.
jamie_data: I’m pulling logs. Looks like the account_filter lost the `is_sandbox=false` clause after yesterday's refactor. Trigger time ~2026-03-15T16:12:10Z.
rachel_onboard: Oof. Those sandbox accounts were supposed to be excluded from all outbound playbooks. Any sample ids?
alex_csops: acct-sbx-12 and acct-test-04. Outbound log: `[2026-03-15T16:14:02Z] outbound send template=churn_alert account=acct-sbx-12 run=ca_771`
ops-bot: command suggestion: /playbook pause churn_alert --reason "exclude-sandbox hotfix"
infra-bot: deploy: playbook-service v4.2.0 deployed by ci at 2026-03-15T15:50:32Z
jamie_data: Quick mitigations: 1) Pause churn_alert, 2) Patch trigger to add `AND a.is_sandbox = false`, 3) Dedupe recent runs with `NOT EXISTS` anti-join for 48h. SQL to find affected runs: `SELECT pr.id, pr.account FROM playbook_runs pr JOIN accounts a ON a.id=pr.account WHERE pr.name='churn_alert' AND pr.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' AND a.is_sandbox = true;` I'll add LIMIT 100 for cancel list.
rachel_onboard: I'll prepare an internal note for owners and flag any customer-facing sends for apology if they accidentally got real alerts.
alex_csops: I can run the pause now. ops-bot, please run cancel on the queued sends for those sandbox accounts after we identify them.
ops-bot: acknowledged: churn_alert paused by alex_csops at 2026-03-15T16:20:05Z reason=exclude-sandbox hotfix
jamie_data: Caning patch to canary host pb-canary-01 with the extra `is_sandbox` guard. Will run a 50-account smoke and report back in ~8m.
alex_csops: Thanks. Opening incident CSOPS-99901 and assigning: jamie_data (patch + backfill), rachel_onboard (owner comms), me (coord + postmortem). ETA initial mitigation 30m.
rachel_onboard: Adding a CI test for playbook triggers to assert sandbox exclusion and a deploy checklist item to validate account filters.
jamie_data: Canary smoke looks good; no sandbox sends in sample. Preparing backfill cancel list now.
alex_csops: Excellent. We'll resume once backfill cancels queued sends and owners confirmed. :thumbsup:
